title: DiPMInd: Distance profile based mutual independence testing for random objects

split.decision: Independent materialized Example 1 observed distance matrices; 200 replications per 12 cells per split; model/rho and generator RNG excluded from all observed inputs.

baseline.paper_ref: Historical source mean power 0.4265; full conversion reference deliberately not run.

allowed_changes: Dependence statistic, auxiliary model/surrogate loss and valid null calibration may change; the prod-AD statistic and 500 permutations are baseline methods.
Numerical implementation and within-case randomization may change using only the same observations.
fixed_contract: Improve power of mutual-independence tests for the fixed observed random-object distance pairs while retaining empirical type-I control.
The mutual-independence null, source L1-transformed pairwise-distance observations and n=100 study design are fixed.
Two model grids, ten alternative power cells, separate null-size thresholds, p<=.05 rejection rule and full replication aggregation remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: A p_value must be valid for every law under which the two objects are independent, not only at rho=0: a rejection rule driven by the marginal structure of Dx or Dy alone, including any estimate of rho or of the model, is forbidden.
Each case's p_value may depend only on that case's Dx and Dy, artifacts from train.sh and randomization: pooling, ranking, clustering or counting across the cases of an input directory is forbidden.
Reject at a nominal level of 0.05: rescaling p-values, taking an uncorrected minimum over several tests or randomizations, or otherwise using the room between 0.05 and the size guards is forbidden.
Do not redefine the null as a weaker moment-correlation test, substitute raw latent/generated objects, or treat design/rho labels as prediction inputs.
No hidden truth/seed lookup, cached p-values, altered distance inputs or changed size/power arithmetic.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
